subject: ComplianceNexus integration intake & evidence-routing plan
messages:
From: Claire Thompson <claire@compliancenexus.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: integrations@compliancenexus.io, Rajesh Singh <rajesh@penpro.co>
Date: Sat, 04 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: ComplianceNexus — integration intake & evidence routing

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for taking this call last week. Per our conversation, ComplianceNexus would like to establish a routed evidence exchange with Redwood so that:

- Customers using Redwood Dedicated/Private can automatically push SOC2 artifact bundles to a tenant in our portal;
- Pen test reports and scoping metadata can be attached to the right account and retained per the customer's retention policy;

I've attached a starter compliance-matrix (columns: artifact type, format, retention, delivery method) to help map fields. A few clarifying questions before we scope an SOW:

1) Do you expose a token-scoped S3 endpoint for evidence collection, or do you prefer API push with signed transfers?
2) Is there an expected max bundle size (zip) we should design for?
3) Which Redwood internal roles should receive webhook failure alerts (ops, security, partner success)?

CC'ing Rajesh from PenPro — they typically perform the pen tests for overlapping customers and will need to validate delivery mechanics for large binary reports.

Suggested next step: 30- to 45-minute technical sync this week to align on transport and retention knobs, then we can draft a short SOW. Are you available Tue/Wed morning PST?

Best,
Claire Thompson
Head of Integrations | ComplianceNexus
[attachment: compliance-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@compliancenexus.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, Rajesh Singh <rajesh@penpro.co>
Date: Sat, 04 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ComplianceNexus — integration intake & evidence routing

Claire — thanks for the clear matrix, this is exactly the level we need to start. Quick answers below, and then I'll loop in infra and integrations for the tech sync: 

- Transport: Redwood prefers API push with signed transfers for smaller artifacts (<25MB). For larger bundles we can support token-scoped S3 PUTs into a restricted bucket per-tenant. We'd like to avoid user-level credentials being circulated.
- Max bundle size: design for up to 500MB per bundle; we'll negotiate chunking for anything larger.
- Alerts: initial routing to Ops (karthik_iyer) + Security (marcus_lin) with partner-success (marissa_cole) on the thread.

I can do Tue 04/06 9:30–10:15am PST or Wed 04/07 8:30–9:15am PST — which works for you + Rajesh?

Next steps from Redwood:
- Karthik and Marissa will draft an "ingest spec" (auth, signing, chunking, schema) and drop into the shared Drive.
- I'll draft a short SOW and include standard data-retention clauses (30/90/365 options) for you to review.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Claire Thompson <claire@compliancenexus.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, Rajesh Singh <rajesh@penpro.co>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ComplianceNexus — integration intake & evidence routing

Looping in some technical details so we can be concrete in the sync:

- Auth model: we will issue a short-lived POST token (15m) minted by our control-plane that maps to a tenant-scoped upload policy. For S3 PUTs we use pre-signed URLs that expire per-upload.
- Schema: artifact metadata should include: customer_id, account_alias, artifact_type (e.g., SOC2-report, pen-test-report, syslog-archive), timestamp_utc, hash_sha256, retention_tier. I'll attach a draft ingest-specs.md to this thread.
- Chunking: multipart uploads supported; we recommend 50MB chunk size for stability.
- Failure semantics: if push fails, CN should retry with exponential backoff up to 6 attempts; on final failure send a webhook to https://hooks.redwoodinference.com/partners/failures/ with HTTP 200/500 semantics.

Questions for ComplianceNexus before sync:
- Do you need event-level indexing for search (we can send an index payload), or will you ingest only opaque blobs and extract on your side?
- For pen test reports specifically: do you need additional metadata fields (scanner version, scope id, CVE references)? Rajesh — can you confirm what PenPro needs?

Attachments: ingest-specs.md (draft)

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Engineer, Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
[attachment: ingest-specs.md (text/markdown)]
From: Rajesh Singh <rajesh@penpro.co>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Claire Thompson <claire@compliancenexus.io>, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2026 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ComplianceNexus — integration intake & evidence routing

Thanks all — quick note from PenPro's side on report delivery and SOW scope: 

- Delivery: We prefer pushing a signed S3 PUT per-report (typically 200–400MB PDFs + attachments). Pre-signed URLs are ideal.
- Metadata: Please include scope_id and test_window_start/test_window_end in the artifact metadata. CVE references are optional but helpful.
- Legal/SOW: I've uploaded a short SOW (penpro-sow-v1.pdf) for review; it includes standard evidence handling, redaction responsibilities, and an incident-disclosure SLA. You should see a DocuSign link if you're the signatory.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/secure/transaction/12345-penpro-sow

We'll be available on the proposed sync dates — prefer Tue 4/6 9:30am PST.

—Rajesh
Rajesh Singh
Engagement Lead | PenPro Security
[attachment: penpro-sow-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@compliancenexus.io>, Rajesh Singh <rajesh@penpro.co>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ComplianceNexus — integration intake & evidence routing

Appreciate the quick turnaround, everyone. Confirming next steps and owners before the sync on Tue 04/06 at 9:30am PST: 

Action items:
- Karthik: finalize ingest-specs.md (auth, multipart, webhook failure contract) and upload to Drive by EOD Mon 04/05.
- Marissa: draft a 1-page commercial addendum for the SOW (retention tiers: 30/90/365 + custom) and share with Claire.
- Marcus: provide security acceptance criteria we require for partner-hosted artifact storage (encryption at rest, TLS1.2+, KMS key rotation cadence).
- Claire: confirm whether ComplianceNexus wants index payloads or opaque blobs (decision needed for schema).
- Rajesh: please confirm SOW signatory and whether PenPro needs a vendor PO prior to testing.

I'll own the calendar invite and the triage doc (drive link below). If anything is blocking, flag here and I'll escalate.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B7-compliance-nexus-integration

Thanks — see you on Tue.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
